---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
leaders <- Batting |>
  summarize(
    career_hr = sum(HR),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .by = playerID
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_hr, n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameFirst, " ", nameLast),
    seasons = str_c(first_year, "–", last_year),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active 1994–2009",
      "Other eras"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
leaders |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_hr, y = fct_reorder(player, career_hr), fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Active 1994–2009" = "firebrick", "Other eras" = "steelblue")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Nine of the top 15 sluggers were active during the 1994–2009 steroid era",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Steroid Era",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
leaders |>
  select(player, career_hr, seasons) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Player", "Career Home Runs", "Seasons")
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  summarize(hr = sum(HR), .by = yearID) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season (1986–2007)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
